designationHistory.name: Mount Hood National Forest
designationHistory.indexText: Oregon: Name changed to Mt. Hood.

sources.name: Establishment and Modification of National Forest Boundaries: A Chronologic Record, 1891–1985 (USDA Forest Service, Lands Staff, 1985), PDF page 58

Presidential Executive Orders, Numbered 1-8030, 1862-1938 (WPA Historical Records Survey, 1944), vol. 1, list entry 3944: Jan. 21, 1924, Oregon National Forest, Oreg., renamed Mount Hood National Forest

Davis, The National Forests of the United States (Encyclopedia of American Forest and Conservation History, App. I, 1983), Forest History Society PDF; compiled partly from an earlier edition of the Forest Service chronologic record, so secondary corroboration only

review.note: Executive Order 3944, Jan. 21, 1924, Coolidge, is right; the order spells the name "Mount Hood National Forest." Predecessor: Oregon National Forest (EO 864, June 30, 1908).
